name: Elzaphan
overview: Elzaphan is a male member of the tribe of Levi, specifically identified as the son of Uzziel. His lineage places him within the Levitical family, which held important priestly and service roles in Israel. There are no additional notes expanding on his personal story or roles beyond his genealogical placement.
namesAndTitles: The name Elzaphan, also rendered as Elizaphan, means 'G-d is my hiding place' in Hebrew. This proper name reflects a trust in God's protection, though it was not given directly by God. The slight variation in spelling appears in different scriptural references but carries the same meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Elzaphan is the son of Uzziel. Additionally, he is inferred to be an ancestor of Shemaiah, Shimri, and Jeiel, indicating his place within a broader Levitical lineage. These connections underscore his role within the priestly family tree.
scriptureSignificance: Elzaphan's significance in the biblical narrative arises primarily from his genealogical position as a Levite descended from Uzziel. His lineage connects him to important Levitical figures who served in religious functions. While the Scriptures do not elaborate on his personal deeds, his place in the Levitical genealogy highlights the continuity of God's ordained priestly service.
